chunks: God has created the heavens and the earth with reason, so that He may reward each soul in accordance with what it has done; and no wrong will be done to them.

key_terms.بِمَا كَسَبَتْ: in accordance with what it earned/did

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of creation according to Surah Al-Muzzammil?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of 'Adl (Divine Justice), affirming that the cosmic order is established for the ultimate accountability of the soul. It reinforces the concept that divine recompense is precise and individualized, ensuring no soul bears the burden of another, which aligns with the Shia emphasis on the fairness of the Hereafter.
